headline: Pakistan Regulator Approves Fuel Charges Adjustment of Rs2.3673 per Unit
summary: NEPRA approved a positive Fuel Charges Adjustment of Rs2.3673 per unit for electricity consumers for September, coming in lower than the initially claimed rate.
why: Regulated energy tariff adjustments directly impact household disposable incomes and the operating costs of industrial electricity consumers.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Nationwide electricity tariff adjustments affect consumer purchasing power and industrial cost structures in Pakistan.
